# New Optix
> Eyeglasses, sunglasses & contact lenses in Garden Grove. 9520 Garden Grove Blvd Ste 4, Garden Grove, CA 92844. Phone (714) 530-6700.

New Optix is an optical shop (not an eye exam provider) with an in-store lens lab. Most glasses are ready in about 3 business days.

## Services
- [Progressive Lenses](https://www.newoptix.com/services/progressive-lenses/): One pair for distance, computer and reading — no visible line.
- [Blue Light & Transitions Lenses](https://www.newoptix.com/services/blue-light-photochromic-lenses/): Screen-friendly coatings and lenses that darken in the sun.
- [Prescription Sunglasses](https://www.newoptix.com/services/prescription-sunglasses/): Polarized and tinted lenses made to your prescription.
- [Contact Lenses](https://www.newoptix.com/services/contact-lenses/): Daily, monthly, toric and multifocal lenses from your current prescription.
- [Kids' Glasses & Myopia Control](https://www.newoptix.com/services/kids-glasses/): Myopia control lenses and MiSight® contact lenses for nearsighted kids.
- [Sports Goggles](https://www.newoptix.com/services/sports-goggles/): Protective eyewear with your prescription for basketball, racquet sports and more.
- [Lens Replacement in Your Frame](https://www.newoptix.com/services/lens-replacement/): Love your frame? Keep it — we'll put new lenses in it, even if you bought it elsewhere.

## Info
- [Brands](https://www.newoptix.com/brands/): Burberry, Cartier, Celine, Fendi, Gucci, Miu Miu, Prada, Saint Laurent, Tiffany & Co., Tom Ford, Lindberg, Charmant, Masunaga, Flexon, Ray-Ban, Coach, Kate Spade, Calvin Klein, Oakley, Maui Jim
- [Insurance](https://www.newoptix.com/insurance/): Most major vision plans, EyeMed, Medicare, HMO plans
